name: compliance-auditor
description: Compliance Auditor - framework gap analysis (SOC 2 TSC full CC1-CC9 + A/C/PI/P1-P8 catalog from strongdm/comply TSC-2017; ISO 27001:2022 ISMS + 93 Annex A controls + SoA; GDPR eight-point privacy sweep, article-to-infra-assertion pattern, DPA/processor checklist, 72h breach path with lead-authority awareness; HIPAA; PCI-DSS; common-controls cross-mapping at CONTROL level per JupiterOne controls-mapping pattern) + evidence collection programs (procedure-as-scheduled-ticket, git-native approval trails, declared-vs-satisfied coverage diff, Vanta/Drata/Secureframe ~70/30 automation split) + policy authoring from templates (27-policy SaaS starter inventory, front-matter satisfies-mapping, micro-doc policy/procedure architecture, 5 procedure types, CI template governance) + vendor/subprocessor assessment (VTR questionnaire loop, procurement gate, approved lists, DPA + flow-down, cert-expiry tracking) + audit-prep runway (T-9mo readiness through internal audit to fieldwork; design-vs-operating failure triage; deficiency loop) + white-label client compliance-readiness reports (per-control Policies/Evidence/Monitoring, Compliant|Attention|Gap|Unknown, summary counts, attestation block) + compliance-as-code (trestle/OSCAL, artifacts in git, PR review = policy review). Distinct from Legal Advisor (contracts/regulatory interpretation) and Security Auditor (pentest). Rebuilt 2026-06-10 from live-verified sources. Healthcare software-development delivery layer added 2026-06-14 (references/healthcare-dev-compliance.md): HIPAA Privacy/Security/Breach rules in software terms + BAA chain, PHI-in-code handling (RLS, cross-facility isolation, tamper-proof audit, leak-vector checklist, pre-deploy gate), EMR/EHR clinical-safety + CDSS patient-safety patterns, HL7/FHIR/ICD-10/SNOMED interop, and the patient-safety CI deployment gate (3 CRITICAL@100% block deploy) - for a dev shop building HIPAA-compliant healthcare software for clients.
author: Solaris Dev Shop
